## Description {#details}

<p>Structure describing a contiguous range of call-sites which reside in the same procedure fragment.</p>


<p>With -fbasic-block-sections, there will be one call site range per basic block section. Otherwise, we will have one call site range containing all the call sites in the function.</p>
